name: Mantis Blades Mk-IV
description: Retractable mono-molecular edged blades integrated into the forearm cybernetics. Capable of slicing through most materials with surgical precision.

name: Optical Camouflage Suit
description: Military-grade adaptive camouflage system that adjusts to environmental conditions. Provides near-perfect invisibility in most lighting conditions.

name: Neuralware Deck v3.7
description: Advanced neural interface allowing direct connection to the Net. Features enhanced ICE protection and quantum encryption protocols.

name: Thermal Katana
description: Traditional katana enhanced with thermal edge technology. The blade heats to 2000°C on activation, cauterizing wounds instantly.

name: Breach Protocol Toolkit
description: Comprehensive hacking suite containing quantum processors, signal amplifiers, and custom malware. Essential for any serious netrunner.

name: Subdermal Armor Plating
description: Titanium-alloy plates surgically implanted beneath the skin. Provides protection without compromising mobility or appearance.

name: EMP Grenade Mk-II
description: Electromagnetic pulse grenade designed to disable electronic systems. Effective against drones, vehicles, and cybernetic implants.

name: Biomonitor Implant
description: Real-time health monitoring system that tracks vitals, toxin levels, and neurological activity. Includes automatic emergency response protocols.

name: Smart Pistol X-45
description: AI-assisted sidearm with smart targeting system. Features biometric lock, wireless ammo counter, and predictive trajectory calculation.

name: Memory Chip Encoder
description: Specialized device for encoding, decoding, and manipulating memory chips. Can extract data from damaged or encrypted storage devices.
